title: Unlock ChatGPT, Gemini, and other AI models for life for a one-time $70 — only today
excerpt: Chat, write, design, edit, and research.
content_html:
TL;DR: Get the 1min.AI Advanced Business Plan for just $69.97 through Aug. 9 and bring leading AI models and other tools into one lifetime workspace.

Credit: 1minAI

$69.97
$540 Save $470.03

AI subscriptions aren’t cheap, but it’s manageable if you only use one model like ChatGPT. However, if you need tools for generating images, writing copy, analyzing documents, or translating between languages, a platform like 1min.AI is a more viable option. 

1min.AI gives you lifetime access to some of the most popular AI tools, including ChatGPT, Gemini, Mistral, and many others. It’s also only $69.97 for a lifetime subscription through today (reg. $540).

Mashable Deals

By signing up, you agree to receive recurring automated SMS marketing messages from Mashable Deals at the number provided. Msg and data rates may apply. Up to 2 messages/day. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Consent is not a condition of purchase. See our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.

1min.AI runs in your browser and pulls a ton of everyday work into one place. You can research keywords, draft blog posts, rewrite and shorten text, generate social posts, and keep a consistent brand voice across projects.

There are tools to summarize or translate documents, chat with multiple PDFs at once, and spin up slide presentations. For visuals, you can generate images from prompts, upscale low-resolution pictures, remove backgrounds, extend edges, or turn rough sketches into cleaner artwork.

Here’s a small sample of the AI models you’ll get access to:

  • GPT-5.5 Pro, GPT-5.4 Pro (OpenAI)

  • Claude 4.1 Opus, Claude 4.5 Sonnet, Claude 4.6 Sonnet (Anthropic)

  • Gemini 2.5 Flash, Gemini 3.1 Pro

  • Llama 3

  • Mistral models

The Advanced Business Plan includes 4,000,000 credits each month, plus the chance to earn up to 450,000 more through daily logins and other tasks. Credits are shared across writing, images, audio, and video, so you can lean harder on whichever tools you need that month.

The plan supports up to 20 members, with shared workspaces, an unlimited prompt library, unlimited storage, and unlimited brand voices. If you don’t use all your credits, they just roll over, so you aren’t missing out if you have a lighter month.

Mashable Deals

By signing up, you agree to receive recurring automated SMS marketing messages from Mashable Deals at the number provided. Msg and data rates may apply. Up to 2 messages/day. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Consent is not a condition of purchase. See our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.

It’s currently only $69.97 (reg. $540) to get a 1min.AI lifetime subscription, but that’s only through today, Aug. 9, at 11:59 pm PT.

StackSocial prices subject to change.

AI 订阅并不便宜，但如果您只使用 ChatGPT 这样的一种模型，它是可以管理的。 然而，如果您需要生成图像、撰写副本、分析文档或在语言之间进行翻译的工具，那么像 1min.AI 这样的平台是一个更可行的选择。

1min.AI 让您可以终生使用一些最流行的 AI 工具，包括 ChatGPT、Gemini、Mistral 等。 截至今日，终身订阅仅需 69.97 美元（原价 540 美元）。

混搭优惠

注册即表示您同意按照提供的号码接收来自 Mashable Deals 的定期自动 SMS 营销消息。 消息和数据速率可能适用。 每天最多 2 条消息。 回复 STOP 可选择退出，回复 HELP 寻求帮助。 同意不是购买的条件。 请参阅我们的隐私政策和使用条款。

1min.AI 在您的浏览器中运行，并将大量日常工作集中到一个地方。 您可以研究关键字、起草博客文章、重写和缩短文本、生成社交帖子，并在各个项目中保持一致的品牌声音。

有一些工具可以总结或翻译文档、同时与多个 PDF 聊天以及启动幻灯片演示。 对于视觉效果，您可以根据提示生成图像、升级低分辨率图片、删除背景、延伸边缘或将粗糙的草图变成更清晰的图稿。

以下是您可以访问的人工智能模型的一小部分示例：

  • GPT-5.5 Pro、GPT-5.4 Pro (OpenAI)
  • 克劳德 4.1 作品、克劳德 4.5 十四行诗、克劳德 4.6 十四行诗（人择）
  • 双子座 2.5 闪存、双子座 3.1 专业版

  • Llama 3

  • 米斯特拉尔型号

高级商业计划包括每月 4,000,000 个积分，此外还有机会通过日常登录和其他任务赚取最多 450,000 个积分。 积分在写作、图像、音频和视频中共享，因此您可以更加依赖当月需要的任何工具。

该计划最多支持 20 名成员，具有共享工作空间、无限提示库、无限存储空间和无限品牌声音。 如果您没有用完所有的积分，它们就会滚动，所以如果您的月份较少，您也不会错过。
